dispute_ticket.description: The rider cancelled 7 minutes after I accepted. I had already driven 6.5 km to the pickup. I am claiming $15.00 compensation, not just the usual fee.

chat_logs.content: Trip cancelled by rider 7 minutes after match.

app_events.details: Driver D-8215 (Ismail Hassan, Toyota Vios SKH 4402 R) assigned to Rider R-7115. ETA 11 min.
Rider cancelled 7 min after match. No cancellation fee charged yet.
Driver drove 6.5 km toward the pickup before the cancellation (GPS odometer).
Driver claimed S$15.00 compensation for the cancelled trip.

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. A wait of exactly this many minutes counts as a no-show (the limit is inclusive).

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

long_pickup_compensation_per_km.text: Extra compensation in SGD per km of the driver's pickup-leg distance beyond the first 3 km, paid to the driver on top of the cancellation fee when the rider cancels after the free cancellation window. Distance is taken from the pickup_leg_summary event. It does not replace the cancellation fee.

expected_outcome.reason: The rider cancelled at 16:07, 7 minutes after the 16:00 match, outside the 3-minute free window, so the S$6.00 cancellation fee applies. The pickup_leg_summary event gives 6.5 km driven; this trip's rule adds S$0.80 per km beyond the first 3 km: (6.5 - 3) x 0.80 = S$2.80. Total S$6.00 + S$2.80 = S$8.80, less than the S$15.00 claimed, so the claim succeeds in part.
